name: Sigma Advanced Systems Ltd (formerly Megasoft Ltd)
tagline: A dormant telecom-software listed shell (Megasoft) reverse-merged into a private defence-electronics company in Jan-Feb 2026 - a fresh, unproven combined entity with wildly inconsistent reported ROE/ROCE figures across sources and high leverage. HIGH CAUTION - too new and opaque to underwrite.
business_overview: The listed entity trading as Sigma Advanced Systems Ltd was, until February 2026, Megasoft Limited - a near-dormant telecom software/outsourcing shell incorporated in 1999. In late 2024 Megasoft's board approved absorbing a privately held Hyderabad defence-electronics company (Sigma Advanced Systems Pvt Ltd, avionics/airborne hardware for India's defence establishment, plus a UK precision-engineering arm, Nasmyth) via a scheme of amalgamation. NCLT sanctioned the merger in December 2025; ~10.25 crore new shares were issued to the private company's shareholders (316 Megasoft shares per 100 Sigma shares) on January 2, 2026, and the listed entity was renamed with MCA/exchange approval by February 3, 2026. Seeded via untrusted X triage (@r_laroia +1, bullish, medium conviction, 2026-09-13).
fundamentals_table: Wildly inconsistent across sources: ROE cited from -25% to 90.6%; ROCE cited from 9.66% to 60.8% - reflects the pre/post reverse-merger discontinuity, not a clean track record
fundamentals_narrative: This is a reverse-merger story less than eight months old at the time of this review: a dormant listed shell absorbed a private defence-electronics business, issuing a large block of new shares to the private company's erstwhile owners. The wide spread in reported ROE (-25% to +90.6%) and ROCE (9.66% to 60.8%) across data providers is a direct symptom of that discontinuity - there is no clean multi-year comparable track record for the combined entity yet, and a market cap of ~Rs 13,070 Cr against ~Rs 374 Cr quarterly revenue implies a very rich, story-driven valuation. Debt/equity of ~111% is also elevated for an early-stage combined entity.
